sources.role: Pinned independently implemented DXF parser/writer source
findings: Stores distinct 62/63/421 roles and removes the post291 extension before primary field decoding.
Reused codes in that extension cannot overwrite primary properties. Source inspection only; no peer execution or semantic oracle claim.

sources.role: Autodesk primary visual-style property API descriptions
findings: The API describes EdgeCreaseAngle in degrees, opacity in0..1 and EdgeIsolines in0..2047. No generic angle conversion is introduced in raw DXF scalar retention.

An application API range is not automatically a DWG/DXF physical encoding bound. Do not transfer the historical native implementation5000 isoline cap into DXF parsing or promote domain validity from successful scalar retention.

changes: Read unambiguous primary face/edge/display values into the existing DRW_VisualStyleBody, preserving private scope/tail latches and the native-only bodyDecoded validation meaning.

Add the separate fixed-size DRW_DxfVisualStyleProperties DTO with 28 integer roles, five real roles, distinct color62/color63/RGB421, occurrence counts, canonical/legacy description counts and original scope/tail/invalid-Boolean observations. Existing models/facade/source-view layouts and virtuals stay unchanged.

Publish immutable original property metadata through getDxfVisualStylePropertiesView only during existing opted-in actual VISUALSTYLE typed/raw callbacks. The internal publication bundle uses the existing reader slot; false clears views and RAII expires pointers on return/throw.

Share original and replay property decoding. Capture separately owned typed/raw property values inline in the existing bounded input; retain replayed metadata in the sealed audit and compare it against both phases before retained model equality can match.

Keep numeric scalar common-parser delegation so new primary handling preserves prior pending-XDATA cursor cleanup. Preserve tolerant ordinary reads, markerless scope, description4 compatibility and last-value behavior while recording presence/duplicates separately.

Repair runtime wire generation: numeric fields use correct writers, every field write is checked, and explicitly authored noncanonical Boolean values are emitted verbatim rather than normalized. No external drawing is committed.
